mode: read-only audit; nothing in the repo was modified
byte_basis: working-tree bytes of git-tracked files; LFS files counted at smudged size
history_note: Deleting files from the working tree does not shrink git history or the Git LFS store. Reclaiming those bytes needs a history rewrite (git filter-repo or git lfs migrate, then LFS prune, force-push and re-clone). That is a separate decision for the owner. It would also change every certified commit SHA and patch SHA-256 pinned in AGENTS.md and the handoffs.
deploy_note: vercel.json outputDirectory is apps/portal, so every deletion under apps/portal/** changes the deployed file set. Per AGENTS.md, an asset change creates a new candidate that needs fresh certification. Deletions under docs/** and apps/hmh-reboot/assets/source/** only shrink the upload; the served output does not change.
